query: MATCH (sp:Spec) OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp) WITH sp.specNumber AS specNumber,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:specNumber}) WITH specNumber,crCnt,count(DISTINCT s) AS secCnt RETURN specNumber,crCnt,secCnt,CASE WHEN secCnt=0 THEN null ELSE round(1.0*crCnt/secCnt,2) END AS density
